title: Zesty American Shrimp Paella
description: A tangy and molten post-workout American dish featuring paella rice and bonito flakes, Whole30-friendly and full of flavor.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and fully cooked, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the paella rice to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth, lemon juice, and bonito flakes to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Return the shrimp to the skillet and stir to combine.
